bhīmasenasya vikramaḥ viśokena dhanaṃjayāgamanasya nivedanam ca
arjunāgamanaṃ bhīmasenasya parākramaḥ śakuninā saha yuddhaṃ ca
saṃśaptakavadhaḥ pāṇḍavasenayā kauravasenāvidhvaṃsanaṃ karṇasya pāñcālābhidravaṇaṃ ca
karṇasya pāñcālavināśanaṃ bhīmaduḥśāsanayoḥ saṃvādaḥ sayuddhaṃ ca
aśvatthāmnaḥ duryodhanaṃ prati śamavākyam, tasya ca pratyākhyānam
karṇārjunayor mahāstrayuddham, bhīmasya karṇaṃ prati kruddhavākyāni
kṛṣṇasya karṇaṃ prati dharmānusmāraṇam, karṇavadhaś ca
yudhiṣṭhirasya harṣo dhṛtarāṣṭrasya vilāpaḥ karṇaparvasamāptiś ca
janamejayasya praśnaḥ saṃjayasya saṃkṣepavākyaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraviṣādaś ca
śalyasya pratijñā kṛṣṇasya ca yudhiṣṭhiraṃ prati śalyavadhopadeśaḥ
pañcapāṇḍavaiḥ śalyasya parivārāya yuddhaṃ yudhiṣṭhiracintā ca
aśvatthāmno rātrau nyagrodhe ulūkakākavadhadarśanaṃ sauptikavadhaniścayaś ca
uttaṅkasya guruśuśrūṣā dakṣiṇārthaṃ maṇikuṇḍalāharaṇāya gamanaṃ ca
uttaṅkasya saudāsena saṃvādaḥ madayantyāś ca kuṇḍalābhijñānayācanam
parīkṣito mṛtajanma kuntyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prati prārthanā ca
pāṇḍavānāṃ śoko nagare parikṣitā ca sāntvanam
pāṇḍavānāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa kuntyā gāndhāryā ca punarmilanam
saṃjayena pāṇḍavānāṃ kurustrīṇāṃ ca tāpasebhyaḥ paricayaḥ
